lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Long ago, in Bethlehem, lived a shepherd boy named David.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He was the youngest of eight brothers.

lines.speaker: jesse
lines.text: David! Keep the sheep safe tonight. Bring them all home.

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: I will, Father. The LORD is my shepherd too!
lines.caption: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

lines.speaker: ui
lines.text: Use the arrows to walk.

lines.speaker: ui
lines.text: Walk near a lost sheep to bring it back.

lines.speaker: ui
lines.text: Press OK to throw a stone.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The sun goes down. Something moves in the grass.

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: Stay close, little ones. I'm here.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The wolves are hungry tonight. Be brave, David.

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: Got you! Back to the flock.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Morning comes. The sheep are safe.

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: Hey! That lamb belongs to my father!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: David chased the lion and saved the lamb from its mouth.

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: LORD, help me again!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The lion and the bear could not beat the LORD's shepherd.

lines.speaker: samuel
lines.text: Is this one the king? No. Not this one either.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Samuel looked at tall Eliab, but God had not chosen him.

lines.speaker: caption
lines.text: The LORD looketh on the heart.

lines.speaker: samuel
lines.text: Are these all your sons, Jesse?

lines.speaker: jesse
lines.text: There is the youngest. He is out with the sheep.

lines.speaker: samuel
lines.text: This is the one.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Spirit of the LORD came upon David from that day on.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: King Saul was troubled, and his heart was dark.

lines.speaker: servant
lines.text: Find a boy who plays the harp well. Jesse's son David!

lines.speaker: saul
lines.text: I feel better. Stay, young David. Stay and play.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: When David played, Saul was refreshed.

lines.speaker: ui
lines.text: Chapter 1 complete — The Shepherd. Next: The Hero.
